title: perfcheck names_successor accepts the retired-feature phrase beside the dropped test file itself
goal: Found in the review of SP-qzip6qar, item ST-l3ky22zo (The retired features' dropped test groups name where their live modules' calls went): names_successor in _tools/perfcheck.py accepts the live-module-calls-went-with phrase only beside a removed module, file or symbol that is not one of the dropped ids' own file or test, so a reason naming only the dropped test file is no successor.

run: import sys,tempfile; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import perfcheck; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); r=perfcheck.names_successor('live-module calls went with test_gone.py', ['_tools/test_gone.py::test_a'], d, ''); print(r); sys.exit(1 if r else 0)
